title: Synthetic Data Generator
summary: A set of FastAPI microservices (DVGB06 project) that each wrap a different tabular synthetic-data backend behind a train/sample/evaluate API. The GaussianCopula and TVAE services build SDV metadata objects and fit sdv.single_table synthesizers, while a separate service trains a standalone CTGAN and both use sdmetrics' QualityReport to score the generated data against the real data.
